quest.title: Provisionally Perpetual Beetle Battle!
quest.description: After having gone through the Arataki Blazing Armor Beetle Battle Boot Camp, Arataki Itto seems to have realized that the strength of Onikabuto is ultimately limited, and a bold new plan is hatched within his mind...

dialogues.speaker: Count Crushmore's Companion God of Cookery
dialogues.text: Hey! Good to see everyone! How's it going? Having fun?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Xiangling, Guoba! You finally made it! Well, Bull-Chuc{RUBY#[S]"Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King"}ker's certainly having a blast.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: The day has finally come!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Guoba-san! I've been training hard at the Arataki Blazing Armor Beetle Battle Boot Camp, and now I wanna show you just how far I've come! ...Uh, and Crimson Staff too!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: If my progress satisfies you, then please, teach me! Show me the way to communicate with Crimson Staff, Crystal Tornado, and all the shelled organisms of this world!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Do that, and I swear, once I become the reigning champion of the beetle-fighting world, I will build a mighty statue in your image at the Arataki Gang's beetle-fighting headquarters!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: What the...! Guoba-san got a brand new Onikabuto?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That does not look normal!

dialogues.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
dialogues.text: It appears to be not a typical Onikabuto shell, but one built of resilient wood... Is it wearing a suit of armor?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: We told Granny all about your Onikabuto boot camp. It really piqued her interest when she heard that Guoba was getting a disciple...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: As it turned out, a friend of hers had made her a whole bunch of gardening and landscaping machines to look after the Silk Flowers on the terrace. They're called Bloom Pruners.

dialogues.speaker: Count Crushmore's Companion God of Cookery
dialogues.text: The Bloom Pruner can transform into the shape of any creature to blend into its environment. Squirrels, Butterflies, Finches, you name it. And of course, Onikabuto too.

dialogues.speaker: Count Crushmore's Companion God of Cookery
dialogues.text: So Master gave Guoba a Bloom Pruner and got it to take the form of an Onikabuto so it can battle against you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...That's pretty hi-tech for a gardening appliance.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Xiangling's master is Madame Ping, so Madame Ping's friend... Aha! Of course!

choices.text: Remind me who that is again?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: No machine can compare to a real, live Onikabuto warrior! Did Guoba-san pick a dumbed-down enemy on purpose so we can showcase all our awesome skills?

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: You may be wise to temper your optimism, Oni King... My beetle senses are failing to detect this Onikabuto's might. Or perhaps... it's too profound for me to fathom.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Eh, it's not even alive. There's nothing for you to sense.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Uhh anyway, Guoba-san may possess limitless power, but a warrior needs to be one with his weapon. The bond between Onikabuto and trainer is forged through blood, sweat, and tears, not wood, mesh, and gears! Crimson Staff and I are like glove and fist.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Let's get this duel going. It's time for Guoba-san to witness my true potential once and for all!

talks.objective: Talk to Arataki Itto and company

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Bull-Chu{RUBY#[S]"Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King"}cker sure made short work of the Bloom Pruner!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: I won! Victory is mine! With my trusty Crimson Staff, I have defeated the mighty Guoba{RUBY#[S]"Calamitous Colossus Count Crushmore"}-san!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Alrighty then... Hoo-hoo, the moment I've been waiting for!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Ahem... Guoba-san, if I have earned your recognition, I humbly ask you to teach me the ways of shelled-organism communication...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: ...Huh? Guoba-san, you look... pleased? But you just lost to me in battle...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Does this mean you're... proud of me for my swift progress?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Aw, shucks, I dunno what to say! Hahahahaha, you're too kind, Guoba-san! ...Ah, you're just being modest, I know you were going easy on me...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: It looks like Guoba's all warmed up now. The Bloom Pruner is ready to operate at full power.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Guoba, remember the plan? In this round, we wanna increase the Bloom Pruner's power output from a tenth of a percent to one percent, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Any higher, and you'll risk knocking Itto's Onikabuto out cold.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, there it is. Paimon knew something was up.

choices.text: What? A tenth of a percent!?

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: As I feared... We've barely scratched the surface...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Wait! Hold on a minute!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: A tenth of one percent? As in... zero-point-one percent? As in... one one-thousandth!?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: You've got... You've gotta be kidding me! All that... was just one ONE-THOUSANDTH of its top power?

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Guoba's a little confused. You did say you wanted to train your Onikabuto to defeat Crystal Tornado, correct?

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: I thought it would go without saying given the size... The Bloom Pruner has to shift rocks the size of casserole dishes, so obviously it has to be pretty strong.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Even then, Crystal Tornado is bigger still... It dwarfs me and Guoba, and it's even taller than you!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: That's impossible... If we were talking twice as strong as the last fight, I think I'd have a shot. Ten times as strong, and we're already looking at losing most, if not all, of the time...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: But a thousand times stronger? Who am I kidding... It's hopeless!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "When your tactics fail, you have to change your point of view. In our journeys far and wide, we often have to think on our feet!"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Clinging to old methods can never solve the problem, no matter how hard you try!"

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: ...Of course, Guoba-san! This is what you've been trying to tell me all along!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: I gotta study mechanics! Then build a suit of armor for Crimson Staff that'll take his abilities to a whole new level!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Or maybe... Heck, I could build a bigger, stronger, mechanical Onikabuto! Piloted by Crimson Staff under my direction!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: An Onikabuto piloting a mechanical Onikabuto? How do you expect to pull that off? And does that even still count as a beetle battle?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Seeing the power of Bloom Pruner has made me realize something... There's a natural limit to Onikabuto's strength.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: People have tried to tell me this before. Shinobu, the grandmaster... especially Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon. Admitting defeat is shameful, but not even trying to mix up your tactics one time — that's just plain stupid!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Guoba-san has shown me a new path: Mechanically modified Onikabuto!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: With this new technique in my arsenal, size will be no obstacle to me and my valiant beetle warriors as we set out to beat Crystal Tornado once and for all!

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Heh... Looks like Guoba's not too sure about all that...

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Mechanics, huh? Hmm, I'd have to get my master to see if her friend would be willing to help. She's the expert...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Did you say expert!? Please, Guoba-san, Chef-sama, my savior! Introduce me!

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Uh-huh...?

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Thinking of becoming the second Arataki Gang member to study in Liyue are you, Boss?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Shinobu!? When'd you get back?

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Time's up. We spent our last Mora on these boat tickets, and if we don't get to the harbor pronto, they'll go to waste.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: But, but, but... Gimme a minute, okay? We're in the middle of an extremely important discussion here!

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Yeah, I heard.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: I was actually very pleased to hear the suggestion of you doing some sort of studying coming out of your own mouth. I have some relevant experience, so I can write a little booklet to get you started.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: But unfortunately, studying in Liyue is very expensive. The Arataki Gang's typical expenditures are a drop in the ocean by comparison. So what do you intend to do about it?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: It'll be fine! I'll just, uhhhh... I'll work like a horse when I get back to Inazuma!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: I know what I'm getting into here, alright? I got it all planned out in my head. It's not like I've never gotten paid work before. Soon as I get earnin', we'll all have cash for the burnin', haha!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: And don't think for one second I'll be abandoning you or the rest of the Arataki Gang neither! I ain't the kind of head honcho that runs off to go study and leaves his gang behind!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: If we're gonna study, we do it as a team! Once I've got enough Mora for everyone's tuition fees, the whole Arataki Gang is coming to Liyue! We'll study together, learn some epic new skills together, and come out the other side as the stronger, smarter Invincible Arataki Gang!

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: You're saying all of the right things... Who are you, and what have you done with Boss?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, Bull-Chu{RUBY#[S]"Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King"}cker! Those were some bold words. You'd better make sure you follow through!

choices.text: Arataki Itto is a man of his word!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hehehe! Of course I, uh, still need to iron out some deets in terms of what kind of work I can get and how much I can rake in per day...

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: In that case, Oni King... I'll stay here in Liyue. Firstly, this will enable me to follow up with Chef-sama and discuss our study plans in detail.

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: Secondly, now that word of the Arataki Blazing Armor Beetle Battle Boot Camp has begun to spread, I'll be able to scout for talented warriors and continue optimizing the Onikabuto training diet.

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: Also, if the Oni King's Right Hand and Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon wish to continue battling, or analyze the battles so far, I'll be here to support them.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Awesome! Good thinking, grandmaster!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Okay, standard procedure applies — I'll let your grandpops know what you're up to so he won't worry about you.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hoo-hoo, man, I am so pumped to see what you'll have for us next time I see you!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: I do need to make one thing clear, though. I can't promise that we'll be able to talk an adeptus into taking you on as students. Yanfei and I will do our best, but we'll just have to see how it goes.

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: The great master of whom you speak boasts a skill others can only dream of — their pride and prestige don't faze us! The important thing is that I, on behalf of the Oni King and the Arataki Gang, can find a way to show them we're serious and sincere in our quest to master the mechanical arts...

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: So I'll need to do some research to find out what kind of gift we should offer if we are to be seen as worthy of learning the mysteries behind the manufacture of the Bloom Pruner.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Boss, we gotta leave right now, or we're not gonna make it in time.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: *sigh* Alright, I guess this is it...

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, Yanfei senpai, Miss Xiangling, Guoba... You've all been a huge help to Boss with this beetle battle event. I really can't thank you enough...

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Please take this as a token of my gratitude. I hope you can find some use for it in your future endeavors.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, you got us a gift! ...Thanks, Shinobu. You're so thoughtful!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: The time has come... Adios, compadre. See ya, Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon. Goodbye, Guoba-san and Chef-sama... and farewell, my savior!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: I'll be back real soon, I promise! We'll meet again!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't make promises you can't keep, Bull-Chu{RUBY#[S]"Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King"}cker!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's good to have ambitions, but don't let yourself get carried away in the heat of the moment. Do what Shinobu tells you, be realistic about what you can achieve, and make sure you pace yourself!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...But of course, if everything works out, Paimon can't wait to see Crimson Staff driving a GINORMOUS mechanical Onikabuto the next time we meet!

choices.text: Don't rely on someone else when you can do it yourself!
